title: Filing C00-4471902, Schedule A
text:
Filing C00-4471902. Schedule A, itemised receipts, for the reporting period covering the second half of 2021.

This page reproduces a public filing. It shows a contribution recorded in a filing submitted by the treasurer of the Central Texas Software Guild, together with the occupation and employer fields exactly as they were entered.

Occupation: platform engineer. Employer: Quarrystone Labs.

Filings of this type are amended frequently and the original document is authoritative. This reproduction is provided for reference and should not be read as a statement about anyone's views.
